name: Shimei
summary: A man of Saul's family from Bahurim who cursed David as he fled from Absalom. David spared him, but Solomon later put him to death for breaking his oath.

key_moments.title: Cursing the King
key_moments.description: As David fled, Shimei came out cursing him and throwing stones and dust. When Abishai wanted to kill him, David told him to leave Shimei alone, for the LORD had bidden him to curse.

key_moments.title: Begging for Mercy
key_moments.description: When David came back over the Jordan, Shimei hurried down to meet him, fell down before him and confessed his sin. David swore to him that he would not die.

key_moments.title: Put to Death for Leaving Jerusalem
key_moments.description: Solomon told Shimei to live in Jerusalem and never go out of it, or he would die. After three years Shimei went to Gath after two runaway servants, and Solomon had him put to death.
